banner.where: mobile/lib/features/home/home_screen.dart:185 (own AdBanner widget, inline at the end of Home)

interstitial.why: No interstitial code: mobile/lib/core/ads/ad_service.dart has no InterstitialAd/onTransition (grep: no hit) and ad_config.dart reads only banner defines. Spec: one inline Home banner, no interstitials (specs/TripNest.md:290, :438). Keep it out.

native.why: No content feed: Home lists the user's own trips (home_screen.dart:125-174, TripCard), and Day ideas is a short hand-written list for five places (mobile/lib/features/ideas/day_ideas_screen.dart:9, :43, :54). Neither is a feed of 8+ content items.

rewarded.why: No quota, premium or IAP (grep premium|in_app_purchase|quota|paywall: no hit); the app makes no network call for its own data. Nothing honest to reward.

blockers: How it does ads today: google_mobile_ads ^9.1.0 directly (mobile/pubspec.yaml:37, lock 9.1.0); own AdBanner (mobile/lib/core/ads/ad_banner.dart:26-110, inline adaptive <=50dp, zero height until filled), AdConfig (ad_config.dart: app ids ~8044208178 / ~7973677521 asserted against the manifests; release build with no ADMOB_BANNER_* define requests NO ad, never test units), ConsentService (UMP) and AdService.initialize (main.dart:52); Privacy choices tile in settings_screen.dart:37,178.

Move onto agl_ads? Not needed now. TripNest needs only the one banner (no native/rewarded recommended), and its wrapper is stricter than agl_ads in one respect: agl_ads serves Google test units in a release build when a unit define is missing (packages/agl_ads/lib/src/ad_ids.dart:147-154), TripNest requests nothing (ad_config.dart resolveUnit). Moving would also add agl_ads' unconditional interstitial preload (ads.dart:94). Revisit only if TripNest later needs native/rewarded or for portfolio consistency.
